name: Amanpuri
insider_take: Amanpuri isn't just a resort—it's where luxury hospitality was redefined, being Aman's very first property that launched an empire of ultra-exclusive retreats.
whats_special: This legendary resort sits on a private headland overlooking the Andaman Sea, featuring traditional Thai pavilions designed by Ed Tuttle. The property pioneered the "Aman effect"—minimal luxury that emphasizes space, privacy, and natural beauty. Each pavilion offers unobstructed ocean views, while the resort's private beach remains one of Phuket's most pristine stretches of sand.
pro_tip: Book the sunset cruise on Amanpuri's traditional longtail boat—it's an exclusive experience that showcases the dramatic limestone karsts of Phang Nga Bay without the crowds.
dont_miss: The resort's holistic wellness center offers traditional Thai treatments in treetop pavilions, and the championship golf course at nearby Phuket Country Club (designed by Sotaro Suzuki) is considered one of Thailand's finest layouts with stunning mountain and sea views.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on pristine Pansea Beach
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with holistic treatments
Luxurious pavilions and villas with private pools and Thai architecture
Impeccable personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Secluded location with limited nearby dining options
